project_type: Roblox Luau game (Pet Simulator) using procedural geometry
build_system: Python script (tools/generate_rbxlx.py) generates BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx from src/ tree
test_framework: No automated tests - validation via XML structure check of generated .rbxlx
